promptPrefix: Professional studio portrait, artificial studio lighting only, no natural light, no windows —
promptSuffix: The setting is built inside the studio: backdrop, set or wall, nothing else. Render in rich colour or high-contrast black and white, whichever suits the mood.
variantDirectives: Full-length on a wide backdrop, the figures small in an empty studio:
Three-quarter length, hands and posture carry the feeling:
Tight close portrait, faces fill the frame:
One light, one backdrop, stark simplicity:
The backdrop and set dominate the frame, the figures secondary:
Fashion editorial framing, the garments are the protagonist:

translations.composed vs. candid: the gap between who you prepare to be and who you actually are
translations.power vs. vulnerability: the strength it takes to let someone see you clearly
translations.formal vs. intimate: the ceremony of being seen giving way to something unguarded
translations.performance vs. presence: when the act drops and there is only the person
translations.controlled vs. unravelling: the precise moment composure becomes something more honest
translations.strength vs. tenderness: force held softly, held back for someone
translations.stillness vs. tension: the body at rest but the mind at full stretch
translations.classical vs. raw: the old language of beauty meeting something that refuses to be beautiful on command
translations.surface vs. depth: the surface and the depth underneath
translations.together vs. alone in the same frame: proximity without connection, or connection across impossible distance
translations.eye contact vs. avoidance: the most intimate thing two people can do, and its refusal
translations.dressed vs. undressed: what clothes perform and what they protect
translations.public self vs. private self: the version you put on and the one that slips through
translations.connection vs. isolation: reaching and not reaching, in the same breath
translations.beauty vs. truth: the flattering lie versus the accurate fact
